نتنحنح (form IIq)
# نَتَنَحْنَحُ (natanaḥnaḥu) /na.ta.naħ.na.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَحْنَحَ (tanaḥnaḥa)
# نَتَنَحْنَحَ (natanaḥnaḥa) /na.ta.naħ.na.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَحْنَحَ (tanaḥnaḥa)
# نَتَنَحْنَحْ (natanaḥnaḥ) /na.ta.naħ.naħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَحْنَحَ (tanaḥnaḥa)
